title: dendranthema variifolium
intro: Dendranthema variifolium, commonly known as Chrysanthemum balsamita, is a perennial herb in the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Dendranthema variifolium include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in alleviating pain, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also used as natural food additives and preservatives.
